name: What kind of paint is best for a bathroom?
description: Satin or semi-gloss finishes with mildew resistance are best for bathrooms to withstand moisture and humidity.

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, a satin or semi-gloss finish is generally recommended due to its durability and resistance to moisture. These finishes are easier to clean and better withstand the high humidity and temperature fluctuations common in bathrooms. When selecting paint, consider its mildew-resistant properties, which can help prevent mold growth in damp environments. Frasheski Construction often advises on paint types that offer enhanced moisture protection, helping to ensure your bathroom retains its fresh look for longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin or semi-gloss finishes with mildew resistance are best for bathrooms to withstand moisture and humidity.
